I am 67 years old now, so I rely on the FISP coupons to get NPK and urea for my main maize plot, which I will mix with manure from my cattle to help the soil. I will use the improved seed that comes with the subsidy because it gives better yield when I apply fertilizer, but I will not spend money on pesticides or irrigation since we always weed by hand and the rains in Mzimba are reliable enough. My family will work most of the days on this plot, but I will hire some young men from the village for about ten days during the heavy work of ridging and weeding since I have over four hectares to look after.
